sources.title: N8N Embedded Chat Interface - GitHub
sources.snippet: The N8N Embedded Chat Interface is a modern, embeddable native web component that enables you to integrate n8n workflows as interactive chatbots on any website. With just a few lines of HTML code, you can transform your n8n automations into user-friendly conversational interfaces.
